notes:
9:16 export: choose Reel / Short 9:16 (or square, 4:5) in Export. It picks the shape that matches your footage, and a new project takes the shape of the first video you import.
One-click updates in the desktop app: Update downloads in the background, then Restart now.
Separate audio: right-click a video in the bin → "Separate audio" saves its sound as a WAV, adds it to the bin and uses the video muted from then on. Also "Use picture only", "Save audio as WAV" and Normalise (−1 dB peak) for audio clips.
Sound tools: volume points (click the yellow line on a selected audio clip), auto-ducking of music under speech, EQ (low cut, bass, mids, treble, presets) and pan per clip, noise reduction (makes a cleaned copy), per-track level meters, and audio-only export as WAV or M4A.
Vertical reframe: the 9:16 tab on the viewer shows a vertical window over a landscape edit. Drag to position it, scroll to zoom, and keyframe it (with smooth, linear or cut moves, or a key at every cut). Export → Frame → Reframe 9:16 renders it at 1080×1920. 4:5 and 1:1 too.
The 9:16 Vertical button above the viewer is bigger and orange, and video clips have an "Open the 9:16 viewer" button in the inspector.
